title: Sharing the Daily Lessons
body:
This is a great app. 5 out of 5 for me. My only issue so far is the share button for the daily lessons. When you’re trying to share the daily lesson and the text is more than can fit in the image, you see “…”. I want everything to fit in the image, it’s either you make everything fit in there or you can have multiple downloadable  images. 

Please fix this ASAP
author: AlvinRampage

title: Great companion for the book
body: So far, this is an excellent companion app if you want to implement the actionable advice from Atomic Habits.
author: Elvis Best
